1.note: private group order-<id> with customFields {orderId, listingId}, members buyer+seller (groups.create by the buyer; admin reads rooms via rooms.adminRooms since it is not a member)

2.note: chat.sendMessage with schema-validated customFields {type, card} + an attachment for Rocket.Chat's own UI; chat.update as the message author (only members can edit in a private group); stream-room-messages delivers the edit

3.note: built-in bad-words list masks listed words only (case-sensitive: `whatsapp` masked, `Venmo`, the phone number and the email delivered: 1/4). A regex filter needs an Apps-Engine app, which an unregistered (Community) workspace cannot install. Reports via chat.reportMessage into the admin Moderation console

4.note: native email via SMTP (offline users, per-room preference) and mobile push via the Rocket.Chat gateway (registration required); no browser push

5.note: Auto-Translate (Google/Microsoft/DeepL paid/LibreTranslate) per user per room; not run: no provider key (Rocket.Chat refuses DeepL free keys)

6.note: groups.invite by a member; groups.history for earlier messages

7.note: typing (stream-notify-room user-activity) and image upload (rooms.media + rooms.mediaConfirm) work; read receipts answer 'This is an enterprise feature' on the unregistered Community workspace
7.gate: registered Starter workspace (free, needs a Rocket.Chat Cloud account) for read receipts
